title: A motto widget: a plugin with code, a compiler error, the widget
user: A widget for the home screen that shows a line of my own, my motto.

content.text: I'll start from the recipe `motto`: a widget with a setting of its own.
A widget for the home screen that shows a line of the person's own, set in its settings.

input.content:
[plugin]
id = motto
name = Motto
description = A widget for the home screen that shows my motto: a line of my own.
version = 0.1.0

[meta]
language = en
name = English
plural = one-other

[messages]
motto.plugin.name = Motto
motto.widget = Motto
motto.setting.text = Motto
motto.setting.text.help = The text the widget shows.

[meta]
language = de
name = Deutsch
plural = one-other

[messages]
motto.plugin.name = Leitspruch
motto.widget = Leitspruch
motto.setting.text = Leitspruch
motto.setting.text.help = Der Text, den das Widget zeigt.

content.text: Font has no draw_text: it is render_text. Fixing that.
Built. Opening it from the tools menu on the X4.

Your plugin is in the reader: the widget Motto, which you put on the home screen from its widget list. It shows a line of your own, and you set the text in its settings. It has German too. Say if you want it changed.
